notes.title: Stellar Reflections - now available
notes.notes:
So, folks, we're live on Steam :).
Not a significant achievement in terms of the art of creating Visual Novels, but a significant personal achievement for the creator, given that it's pretty much just one person (who did get a bit of help here and there though ;)), and their first ever Steam release.
Hopefully you enjoy this little short story.
